system.description:
A collection of tools and supplies for patching up injuries. Versions exist at various tech levels, with different kinds of tools at each, similar to first aid kits but with a wider range of supplies and tools.

A Medical Kit allows a character to treat Injuries a character has suffered, as well as providing the means to provide longer-term care to heal treated injuries. A kit can treat Injuries with a damage rating of the kit’s Tech Level +1. Medical kits are powered and recharge after a Breather rest.
